Hi folks... Reverand Blackwood's ability reads that he inflicts +1
damage with any strike card that requires Thaumaturgy. Question is, if
you do a theft of vitae does the the strike now cause 1 damage and 2
blood drain? Would the damage or the blood drain resolve first? (I
imagine that is the good Reverand's choice?).

Daniel

re: Reverand Blackwood, !Tremere, DOM, THA, obf, 6 cap bishop.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3AC36CEF...@qwest.net>, TigToad <tig...@qwest.net>
writes

>Hi folks... Reverand Blackwood's ability reads that he inflicts +1
>damage with any strike card that requires Thaumaturgy. Question is, if
>you do a theft of vitae does the the strike now cause 1 damage and 2
>blood drain?

No.

There is no damage in a steal blood strike to modify, so the modifier
cannot apply to it.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
TigToad wrote:
>
> Hi folks... Reverand Blackwood's ability reads that he inflicts +1
> damage with any strike card that requires Thaumaturgy. Question is, if
> you do a theft of vitae does the the strike now cause 1 damage and 2
> blood drain? Would the damage or the blood drain resolve first? (I
> imagine that is the good Reverand's choice?).

No. His ability only affect damage-dealing strikes from strike cards.

Online rulings:
* Adding damage to strikes which are not damage dealing strikes
will not deal damage (e.g., using Lucky Blow and choosing your
Rowan Ring melee weapon won't deal damage) [RTR 21-FEB-1996]
